description: This file provides Danish localization strings for the Select2 jQuery plugin version 4.0.6-rc.1, defining Danish translations for various UI messages used within the plugin.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns Danish message indicating that results could not be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns Danish message indicating the user has entered too many characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns Danish message indicating the user needs to enter more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns Danish message indicating more results are loading.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a Danish message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns Danish message indicating no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns Danish message indicating a search operation is in progress.
